title: 1D Gaussian Acquisition Smoke (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `gaussian1d_smoke` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Minimal sanity gate asking whether public training acquires a single scalar Gaussian N(2, 0.5^2) from random initialization within 1,000 updates, matching its mean, standard deviation, and full CDF (KS <= 0.05).
failure_mode: Broken critic scaling, NaN divergence, or collapsed variance prevents even a unimodal 1D Gaussian from converging within bounds.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `gaussian1d_smoke` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
